baslik: Hundreds killed as Palestinian-Israeli conflict erupts again
metin: Hamas launched a surprise attack on October 7, 2023, with fighters breaking through Gaza's border fence and infiltrating Israeli communities. The assault killed at least 200 Israelis and wounded 1,100, marking the deadliest attack on Israel in decades. Hamas gunmen attacked as many as 22 locations, traveling up to 24 kilometers from the Gaza border during the Jewish holiday of Simchat Torah. Israel declared war and launched retaliatory airstrikes on Gaza, killing at least 198 Palestinians and wounding over 1,610. Hamas also abducted Israeli civilians and soldiers. Israeli Prime Minister Netanyahu vowed Israel would 'defeat them ... and take revenge,' while Hamas military leader Mohammed Deif stated the operation was in response to Gaza's blockade and settlement expansion.
yazar: Daniel Bellamy & Euronews with AFP, AP, EFE
